terminals.name: astro-dev
terminals.description: Astro dev server with HMR for the templated pages under src/pages (spot pages, regulations, etc.). Note: the legacy homepage and other not-yet-templated pages are only assembled at build time, so they 404 here — use the site-preview terminal for the complete site.

terminals.name: site-preview
terminals.command: npm run build && npx astro preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4322
terminals.description: Runs the full production build (scout index -> regs index -> astro build -> merge legacy -> parity warn) and serves the complete static site (all ~1238 pages, byte-identical clean URLs) from dist/. Rebuilds on every boot to stay in sync with the checked-out source.
